info.name: 📌 TypeSafe AI API
info.description:
### About TypeSafe AI

"TypeSafe AI is an AI lab building machine-native intelligence infrastructure for automation, designed to make decisions within software."

TypeSafe AI builds its own System One decision models, such as Jev, which return typed decisions instead of text. On the workspace overview it is listed under **Model makers**.

### Prerequisites

- Postman Account
    
- TypeSafe AI Account: [https://console.typesafe.ai/](https://console.typesafe.ai/)
    

### Usage

1. Create a fork
    
2. Update collection variables
    
3. Send requests

Start with the 🚀 Get Started folder.

Add your key to your **Postman Vault** as `typesafe_api_key` (Vault icon in the footer, then **Add secret**, using that exact name). Requests read it as `{{vault:typesafe_api_key}}`, so your key never leaves your device.

### Documentation

- API: [https://docs.typesafe.ai/api](https://docs.typesafe.ai/api)
    
- Models: [https://docs.typesafe.ai/models](https://docs.typesafe.ai/models)
